course.title: Vector Analysis and Linear Algebra
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Let, $P _ { 2 }$ be the vector space of all polynomials with real coefficients of degree 2 or less and $S = \{ P _ { 1 } , P _ { 2 } , P _ { 3 } , P _ { 4 } \}$ where, $P _ { 1 } ( x ) = - 1 + x + 2 x ^ { 2 } , P _ { 2 } ( x ) = x + 3 x ^ { 2 } , P _ { 3 } ( x ) = 1 + 2 x + 8 x ^ { 2 }$
$P _ { 4 } ( x ) = 1 + x + x ^ { 2 }$ . Find a basis of $P _ { 2 }$ among the vectors of S. Hence, express the vector that is not in the basis as a linear combination of the basis vectors.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
